title: Hunt-Hess Classification
sources: Hunt WE, Hess RM. J Neurosurg 1968
purpose: Severity grading of aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage — prognosis and triage for neurosurgical intervention.

tiers.label: Grade I
tiers.description: Asymptomatic, or mild headache and slight nuchal rigidity

tiers.label: Grade II
tiers.description: Moderate-to-severe headache, nuchal rigidity, no deficit other than cranial nerve palsy

tiers.label: Grade III
tiers.description: Drowsiness, confusion, or mild focal deficit

tiers.label: Grade IV
tiers.description: Stupor, moderate-to-severe hemiparesis, early decerebrate rigidity

tiers.label: Grade V
tiers.description: Deep coma, decerebrate posturing, moribund appearance

interpretation.label: Higher grade → higher perioperative mortality and worse outcome
interpretation.detail: Grades I-III are generally candidates for early aneurysm securing; IV-V are individualized.
